name: Kamadev Moharana/କାମଦେବ ମହାରଣା

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Kamadev Moharana is an Odia poet and fiction writer whose imagination is rooted in the rivers and coast around Astarang. In an interview with Odisha Sambad, he recalls the landscape of his childhood in Badagola and the books that drew him towards literature. His collections include Kabi, Chhai Saha Sabudina and Coffee Bagicha. He describes poetry as a witness to the social and cultural life of its time.

His Kabita Live poems bring that relationship between place and people into focus. ‘ଘନ ବେହେରାର ଗୀତ’ follows a fisherman into darkness, carrying a mother’s warning, the demands of home and an epic song towards the sea. ‘ସେମାନେ କହୁଥିବା ଏକ ନଷ୍ଟ ସ୍ଵର୍ଗର ଫଟୋଚିତ୍ର’ remembers a river, banyan tree and village gathering place as a shared world gradually damaged and lost. Landscape here holds both livelihood and communal memory.
